description:
Follow-up to op-4wl.2/op-4wl.4 (pipe-38 K=0.8->17.8 SAM adoption, 2026-07-15). A single uniform form loss K=17.8 fixes the mid/high-flow DRACS over-prediction but cannot fix the two lowest-flow coupled cases B1 (655W) and C1 (841W), which already under-predict at K=0.8 and worsen to -6.62%/-6.80% under added resistance (form loss ~ v^2, negligible at low flow). They currently carry a documented per-point widened DRACS tolerance (B1 0.062->0.0676; C1 0.0676->0.069).

Proper fix: give pipe 38 a velocity/Reynolds-dependent loss of the form f_darcy = form_loss + b*Re^c, which is ALREADY supported by InsulatedFluidComponent::new_custom_component (see insulated_pipes_and_fluid_components/mod.rs:204, new_custom_component with reynolds_coefficient b and reynolds_power c). Shape needed: small a at low Re (helps B1/C1 low-flow under-prediction) rising to ~K=17.8-equivalent at high Re (preserves the mid/high-flow over-prediction fix). Calibrate b,c across all 25 coupled cases; re-validate the isolated-DRACS SAM reference (currently defined at constant K=17.8); then tighten B1/C1 tolerances back to the benchmark bound (0.062/0.0676) and recompute regression literals. Deferred from op-4wl.4 because per-iteration cost is a full ~50-min 25-case run and it would also require re-deriving the isolated SAM calibration.
title: Velocity/Reynolds-dependent pipe-38 form loss to fix coupled DRACS low-flow cases (B1/C1)

description:
FIRST task in PETIR (op-chyp). Blocks every port task. Do not write a line of ported code before this closes.

## Do

1. Add a crate .gitignore for the vendored clone BEFORE cloning, per the
   workspace vendor rule (upstream_source/<Project>/ is gitignored, never
   committed; only upstream_source/README.md is tracked). Cloning first leaves
   a large untracked tree in git status and risks committing it.
2. git clone --depth 1 https://git.savannah.gnu.org/git/gsl.git upstream_source/GSL
   (mirror: https://github.com/ampl/gsl). Same for Octave if Octave routines
   are actually wanted — decide per routine, do not clone speculatively.
3. READ upstream COPYING verbatim. Record: exact licence name and VERSION,
   whether it says 'or later', the commit SHA, the date accessed, and the
   sha256 of COPYING. Also read a representative per-file header (e.g.
   cheby/cheb.c) for the per-file copyright line — GSL's copyright is held by
   individual authors and the FSF, and the authors differ per module.
4. Write it all into crates/petir/upstream_source/README.md and the crate
   NOTICE.

## Why this is its own task, and why it is first

GSL is UNDERSTOOD to be GPL-3.0-or-later. That has not been checked against
the file. On 2026-09-10 outram-park-fork-pflotran's NOTICE asserted
LGPL-2.1-or-later from documentation and OSTI/DOECODE records; reading the
actual upstream LICENSE showed LGPL-3.0, and the relicensing clause the NOTICE
cited (LGPL-2.1 section 3) does not exist in LGPLv3. The wrong version AND the
wrong legal mechanism, shipped in a NOTICE, for two months. Verify from the
file, twice if possible (raw fetch + clone, compare digests).

## Acceptance

- upstream_source/README.md records licence name+version, 'or later' status,
  commit SHA, date accessed, COPYING sha256.
- Crate NOTICE names the copyright holders as the per-file headers state them.
- GPL-3.0-only compatibility argument written out with the actual clause cited,
  not asserted.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Done 2026-09-14 (d801e59b2). GSL 2.8 @ cf180cd7 vendored; licence VERIFIED from per-file headers (GPL-3.0-or-later), not from COPYING -- whose 'either version 3 or later' line at :639 is the How-to-Apply APPENDIX, not GSL's grant. COPYING sha256 8ceb4b9e...b65b903. Caveat recorded: savannah unreachable (proxy 403), cloned from the ampl mirror; mirror fidelity NOT independently verified, SHA+digests recorded so it can be checked later.

title: PETIR: vendor GSL upstream and VERIFY its licence from COPYING before any port
